injury_research_overlay.policy: Never change original pregame model values. Block risky research; do not assume not-listed players are healthy. Minutes sensitivity is a hypothetical proportional illustration, not a model prediction.

historical_backtest.notice: No same-date or future-label leakage. Earlier-date global/player means are diagnostic baselines, not independent betting-market evidence.

alerts_policy: GitHub issue notification on state changes when enabled by workflow. Do not disclose secrets, publish picks, or claim iOS push notifications.
notice: Monitoring plus conservative injury research gate, not a modification to trained models or verified real-time player availability.
